generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a spreading, many-stemmed shrub with bright red young stems, opposite oval leaves with curving veins and flat clusters of small white flowers. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 2.8 m tall at 12 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: mid-green leaves; red stems; white flower clusters. Fruit (plant roadmap P4), as in mid-July: flat-topped clusters of berries, green turning white. Its year (appearance.organs.bloom.season) is authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands: flat white clusters in May and June; berries green, white from late July, eaten into November. The forest's packages show day 196 (mid-July) until the phenology of plant roadmap P5 sets the day from the date and the local climate. Bark pattern (plant roadmap P4, `bark_pattern`): smooth red stems with lenticels; set from general knowledge of the species, not measured.
